issues.title: test(vn-holidays): add tests/holidays.test.ts with edge cases beyond the golden fixtures
issues.body:
## Problem
`vn-holidays` has only `tests/holidays-golden.test.ts` (4 `it` blocks that iterate `tests/golden/vn-holidays.json`). Every other skill has a dedicated `tests/<name>.test.ts`, and CONTRIBUTING requires one. Behaviour that is not a pure input->output case is untested: error results for malformed dates, `announced: false` for years without data, `addWorkingDays` with n=0 or a negative n, and ranges that cross a year boundary.

## Acceptance
- [ ] New `tests/holidays.test.ts` with >= 20 cases covering: invalid date input (`ok: false` with code and hint), a year with no announcement (`announced: false`, statutory days only), weekend-collision compensation, `addWorkingDays` with n = 0 and with a negative n, and a year-boundary crossing
- [ ] Only assert behaviour the current implementation already has. If a case exposes a bug, report it in the PR instead of silently changing behaviour
- [ ] Do not edit `packages/core/data/*.json`
- [ ] `pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm format:check` pass
issues.triage_reason: The holidays skill has no dedicated test file, unlike the other skills, and CONTRIBUTING requires >= 20 tests per skill.
issues.summary: Added tests/holidays.test.ts with 33 characterization tests (invalid input, unannounced year, weekend compensation, addWorkingDays n=0/negative, year boundary). No behaviour changes; no bugs found.
issues.pr_title: test(vn-holidays): add edge-case tests beyond golden fixtures
issues.pr_body:
## What & why

Closes #60

Adds `tests/holidays.test.ts` with 33 characterization tests for `vn-holidays`. Before this, the skill only had `tests/holidays-golden.test.ts`, which covers pure input/output cases. The new tests cover:

- invalid or malformed date input: `ok: false` with a code and a hint
- a year with no announcement: `announced: false`, statutory days only
- weekend-collision compensation
- `addWorkingDays` with n = 0 and with a negative n
- ranges that cross a year boundary

The tests assert only what the current implementation already does. No source code or data files changed, and no bugs were found.

Acceptance from the issue:

- [x] New `tests/holidays.test.ts` with >= 20 cases (33) covering invalid input, unannounced year, weekend compensation, `addWorkingDays` n = 0 and negative n, and a year-boundary crossing
- [x] Only existing behaviour is asserted; no bug found, so nothing to report
- [x] `packages/core/data/*.json` not edited
- [x] `pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm format:check` pass

## Checklist

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat|fix|docs|data|test|refactor|perf|build|ci|chore(scope): …`)
- [x] Tests added or updated (golden test for every bug fix)
- [x] `pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm format:check` pass locally
- [x] Core stays offline (no `fetch`/HTTP in `packages/core`)
- [x] Data changes go through `scripts/build-data.ts` and `SOURCES.md` (source + license)
- [x] SKILL.md / README updated if behaviour changed

The last three boxes are ticked because they do not apply: only a test file was added. The golden-test item is also not applicable, since this is not a bug fix.
issues.repro_notes: Issue asks for a characterization test file for existing behaviour; such tests pass on base, so no failing test can be written for the right reason. Left unchanged.

proposals.title: vn-pit: personal income tax calculator (needs a legal source first)
proposals.body:
## Problem
ROADMAP RM-015 is still `idea`. A PIT calculator needs the current brackets, personal and dependant deduction amounts, insurance rates and effective dates. None of these are in the repository.

## Acceptance
- [ ] The maintainer cites the legal source and effective dates in this issue
- [ ] Then: core function + CLI command + MCP tool + `skills/vn-pit/SKILL.md` with Vietnamese trigger words + >= 20 tests in `tests/vn-pit.test.ts` + an entry in `tests/skills.test.ts`
- [ ] Rates live in a data file with a source URL, not in code
proposals.rationale: [needs a person] RM-015 has no open issue. It cannot be implemented without a legal source that only the maintainer can supply.

kv.value: The repo is consistent on MCP tool names and the README tool lists, and the open issue list is empty. The weak spot I saw is thin dedicated test coverage for vn-holidays. The remaining roadmap items need a human (legal sources, credentials, samples, or recordings).
